note: Golden cases for the TypeScript runtime. Written by the Ruko team (not from real people). Phone numbers, UPI IDs and account numbers are fake. ml/train.py adds the Python reference outputs and writes server/ml/__tests__/fixtures/golden.json. 'expect' is the behaviour we want; the TS tests mark documented misses with known_failure instead of hiding them.
